source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network (original), Recipe modification adapted from SNAP-Ed New York, October 2023

steps.instruction: Add 1 cup of flour, 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda to a bowl.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, 1/2 cup of packed brown sugar and 1 cup of oats.
Add 1/2 cup of margarine and cut it into crumbs.
steps.spoken: Add 1/2 cup of margarine or butter. Use 2 table knives to cut it into crumbs.

steps.instruction: Grease the bottom and sides of the baking dish with cooking spray.
Spread half of the crumb mixture in the greased dish.
Put the apple slices in the baking dish.
Top the apples with the rest of the crumb mixture.
Cut into squares to make 24 bars.
steps.spoken: Cut into squares to make 24 bars. The bars will fall apart easily.
